title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 17. The Favour to the Devotees
html:
The devotees of Gauda, headed by Advaita, set out for Nilachala; the Lord sends His companions to meet them, and then Himself goes out with the devotees of the Kshetra to Lake Narendra, where the meeting takes place

Verse 1

अथ भक्तगणाः सर्वे ये ये गौडनिवासिनः।
गन्तुमिच्छन्ति गौराङ्गदर्शनाय नीलाचलम्॥१॥

atha bhaktagaṇāḥ sarve ye ye gauḍanivāsinaḥ|
gantumicchanti gaurāṅgadarśanāya nīlācalam||1||

atha — now; bhakta-ganah — the devotees; sarve — all; ye ye — who; gauda-nivasinah — living in Gauda; gantum — to go; ichchhanti — wish; gauranga-darshanaya — to see Gauranga; nilachalam — to Nilachala.

1Now all the devotees who lived in Gauda wished to go to Nilachala to see Gauranga.

Verse 2

आचार्यः श्रीमदद्वैत ईश्वरो जगतां गुरुः।
सगणः परमानन्दः श्रीवासः सह भ्रातृभिः॥२॥

ācāryaḥ śrīmadadvaita īśvaro jagatāṁ guruḥ|
sagaṇaḥ paramānandaḥ śrīvāsaḥ saha bhrātṛbhiḥ||2||

acharyah — the Acharya; shrimat-advaitah — glorious Advaita; ishvarah — the Lord; jagatam — of the worlds; guruh — the Teacher; sa-ganah — with his followers; parama-anandah — full of supreme bliss; shrivasah — Srivasa; saha — together; bhratribhih — with his brothers.

2There was glorious Advaita Acharya, the Lord and Teacher of the worlds, with His followers, full of supreme bliss; Srivasa with his brothers;

Verse 3

आचार्यरत्नः श्रीचन्द्रशेखराचार्य एव च।
पुण्डरीकाक्षको विद्यानिधिः प्रेमनिधिस्तथा॥३॥

ācāryaratnaḥ śrīcandraśekharācārya eva ca|
puṇḍarīkākṣako vidyānidhiḥ premanidhistathā||3||

acharya-ratnah — Acharyaratna; shri-chandrashekhara-acharyah — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; eva cha — and also; pundarika-akshakah — Pundarikaksha (Pundarika); vidyanidhih — Vidyanidhi; prema-nidhih — the treasury of love; tatha — likewise.

3Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya, called Acharyaratna; Pundarika Vidyanidhi, the treasury of love;

Verse 4

गङ्गादासाख्यकश्चैव पण्डितः सद्गुणान्वितः।
वक्रेश्वरः पण्डितश्च प्रद्युम्नब्रह्मचार्यपि॥४॥

gaṅgādāsākhyakaścaiva paṇḍitaḥ sadguṇānvitaḥ|
vakreśvaraḥ paṇḍitaśca pradyumnabrahmacāryapi||4||

gangadasa-akhyakah — named Gangadasa; cha eva — and also; panditah — the Pandita; sat-guna-anvitah — endowed with good qualities; vakreshvarah — Vakreshvara; panditah — Pandita; cha — and; pradyumna-brahmachari — Pradyumna Brahmachari; api — also.

4the pandita named Gangadasa, endowed with every good quality; Vakreshvara Pandita and Pradyumna Brahmachari1;

Verse 5

हरिदासाख्यठक्कुरो हरिदासद्विजस्तथा।
श्रीवासुदेवदत्तः श्रीमुकुन्ददत्त एव च॥५॥

haridāsākhyaṭhakkuro haridāsadvijastathā|
śrīvāsudevadattaḥ śrīmukundadatta eva ca||5||

haridasa-akhya-thakkurah — the Thakura named Haridasa; haridasa-dvijah — Haridasa the brahmana; tatha — also; shri-vasudeva-dattah — Sri Vasudeva Datta; shri-mukunda-dattah — Sri Mukunda Datta; eva cha — and also.

5Haridasa Thakura and Haridasa the brahmana; Sri Vasudeva Datta and Sri Mukunda Datta;

Verse 6

श्रीशिवानन्दसेनश्च पुत्रदारासमन्वितः।
श्रीगोविन्दघोष एव मुकुन्दो गायकोत्तमः॥६॥

śrīśivānandasenaśca putradārāsamanvitaḥ|
śrīgovindaghoṣa eva mukundo gāyakottamaḥ||6||

shri-shivananda-senah — Sri Shivananda Sena; cha — and; putra-dara-samanvitah — with his sons and wife; shri-govinda-ghoshah — Sri Govinda Ghosha; eva — also; mukundah — Mukunda; gayaka-uttamah — the best of singers.

6Sri Shivananda Sena with his sons and wife; Sri Govinda Ghosha and Mukunda, the best of singers;

Verse 7

लेखको विजयश्चैव श्रीसदाशिवपण्डितः।
पुरुषोत्तमः सञ्जयश्च श्रीमानाख्यकपण्डितः॥७॥

lekhako vijayaścaiva śrīsadāśivapaṇḍitaḥ|
puruṣottamaḥ sañjayaśca śrīmānākhyakapaṇḍitaḥ||7||

lekhakah — the scribe; vijayah — Vijaya; cha eva — and also; shri-sadashiva-panditah — Sri Sadashiva Pandita; purushottamah — Purushottama; sanjayah — Sanjaya; cha — and; shriman-akhyaka-panditah — the Pandita named Shriman.

7Vijaya the scribe and Sri Sadashiva Pandita; Purushottama, Sanjaya and the pandita named Shriman;

Verse 8

श्रीनन्दनाख्यको ब्रह्मचारी शुक्लाम्बरस्तथा।
खोलावेचेतिविख्यातः स भक्तः श्रीधरः सुखी॥८॥

śrīnandanākhyako brahmacārī śuklāmbarastathā|
kholāvecetivikhyātaḥ sa bhaktaḥ śrīdharaḥ sukhī||8||

shri-nandana-akhyakah — named Sri Nandana; brahmachari — the brahmachari; shuklambarah — Shuklambara; tatha — also; kholavecha — "Kholavecha"; iti — thus; vikhyatah — known; sah — that; bhaktah — devotee; shridharah — Shridhara; sukhi — happy.

8Sri Nandana and Shuklambara Brahmachari; and the blissful devotee Shridhara, known as Kholavecha2;

Verse 9

लेखकपण्डितश्चैव गोपीनाथाख्यपण्डितः।
श्रीगर्भपण्डितश्चापि पण्डितो वनमालिकः॥९॥

lekhakapaṇḍitaścaiva gopīnāthākhyapaṇḍitaḥ|
śrīgarbhapaṇḍitaścāpi paṇḍito vanamālikaḥ||9||

lekhaka-panditah — the scribe-pandita; cha eva — and also; gopinatha-akhya-panditah — the Pandita named Gopinatha; shri-garbha-panditah — Sri Garbha Pandita; cha api — and also; panditah — Pandita; vanamalikah — Vanamali.

9the scribe-pandita and the pandita named Gopinatha; Sri Garbha Pandita and Vanamali Pandita;

Verse 10

जगदीशः पण्डितश्च हिरण्याख्यश्च वैष्णवः।
बुद्धिमन्ताख्यखानश्च आचार्यः श्रीपुरन्दरः॥१०॥

jagadīśaḥ paṇḍitaśca hiraṇyākhyaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ|
buddhimantākhyakhānaśca ācāryaḥ śrīpurandaraḥ||10||

jagadishah — Jagadisha; panditah — Pandita; cha — and; hiranya-akhyah — named Hiranya; cha — and; vaishnavah — the Vaishnava; buddhimanta-akhya-khanah — the Khan named Buddhimanta; cha — and; acharyah — Acharya; shri-purandarah — Sri Purandara.

10Jagadisha Pandita and the Vaishnava named Hiranya; Buddhimanta Khan and Sri Purandara Acharya;

Verse 11

राघवः पण्डितश्चैव वैद्यसिंहमुरारिकः।
श्रीगरुडपण्डितश्च गोपीनाथाख्यसिंहकः॥११॥

rāghavaḥ paṇḍitaścaiva vaidyasiṁhamurārikaḥ|
śrīgaruḍapaṇḍitaśca gopīnāthākhyasiṁhakaḥ||11||

raghavah — Raghava; panditah — Pandita; cha eva — and also; vaidya-simha-murarikah — Murari, the lion among physicians; shri-garuda-panditah — Sri Garuda Pandita; cha — and; gopinatha-akhya-simhakah — the Simha named Gopinatha.

11Raghava Pandita and Murari, the lion among physicians3; Sri Garuda Pandita and Gopinatha Simha;

Verse 12

श्रीरामपण्डितश्चैव श्रीनारायणपण्डितः।
दामोदरः पण्डितश्च रघुनन्दनठक्कुरः॥१२॥

śrīrāmapaṇḍitaścaiva śrīnārāyaṇapaṇḍitaḥ|
dāmodaraḥ paṇḍitaśca raghunandanaṭhakkuraḥ||12||

shri-rama-panditah — Sri Rama Pandita; cha eva — and also; shri-narayana-panditah — Sri Narayana Pandita; damodarah — Damodara; panditah — Pandita; cha — and; raghunandana-thakkurah — Raghunandana Thakura.

12Sri Rama Pandita and Sri Narayana Pandita; Damodara Pandita and Raghunandana Thakura;

Verse 13

श्रीमुकुन्दनरहरिचिरञ्जीवसुलोचनाः।
रामानन्दवसुश्चैव सत्यराजादयस्तथा॥१३॥

śrīmukundanaraharicirañjīvasulocanāḥ|
rāmānandavasuścaiva satyarājādayastathā||13||

shri-mukunda-narahari-chiranjiva-sulochanah — Sri Mukunda, Narahari, Chiranjiva and Sulochana; ramananda-vasuh — Ramananda Vasu; cha eva — and also; satyaraja-adayah — Satyaraja and others; tatha — also.

13Sri Mukunda, Narahari, Chiranjiva and Sulochana4; Ramananda Vasu, Satyaraja5 and others.

Verse 14

सर्वे श्रीकृष्णचैतन्यप्राणाः प्रेमसमन्विताः।
आचार्यप्रभुणा सार्धमाययुः पुरुषोत्तमम्॥१४॥

sarve śrīkṛṣṇacaitanyaprāṇāḥ premasamanvitāḥ|
ācāryaprabhuṇā sārdhamāyayuḥ puruṣottamam||14||

sarve — all; shri-krishna-chaitanya-pranah — whose very life is Sri Krishna Chaitanya; prema-samanvitah — full of love; acharya-prabhuna — with Acharya Prabhu; sardham — together; ayayuh — came; purushottamam — to Purushottama.

14All of them, whose very life is Sri Krishna Chaitanya, full of love, came with Acharya Prabhu to Purushottama.

Verse 15

श्रीमन्नरेन्द्रमायातान् भक्तान् सर्वेश्वरो हरिः।
निकटस्थान् भक्तगणान् प्रेषयामास सत्वरम्॥१५॥

śrīmannarendramāyātān bhaktān sarveśvaro hariḥ|
nikaṭasthān bhaktagaṇān preṣayāmāsa satvaram||15||

shrimat-narendram — at glorious (Lake) Narendra; ayatan — arrived; bhaktan — (to meet) the devotees; sarva-ishvarah — the Lord of all; harih — Hari; nikata-sthan — who were near Him; bhakta-ganan — the devotees; preshayam asa — sent; satvaram — quickly.

15Hari, the Lord of all, at once sent the devotees who were near Him to meet the devotees who had arrived at glorious Lake Narendra.

Verse 16

पश्चादेव स्वयमपि गन्तुं चक्रे मनः प्रभुः।
भक्तप्राणो भक्तवशो भक्तानां प्रीतिदः सदा॥१६॥

paścādeva svayamapi gantuṁ cakre manaḥ prabhuḥ|
bhaktaprāṇo bhaktavaśo bhaktānāṁ prītidaḥ sadā||16||

pashchat eva — afterwards; svayam api — He Himself too; gantum — to go; chakre manah — made up His mind; prabhuh — the Lord; bhakta-pranah — whose life is His devotees; bhakta-vashah — subject to His devotees; bhaktanam — to the devotees; priti-dah — giving joy; sada — always.

16Then the Lord, whose life is His devotees, who is subject to His devotees and ever gives them joy, resolved to go Himself.

Verse 17

नित्यानन्दप्रभुश्चैव पण्डितः श्रीगदाधरः।
पुरी श्रीपरमानन्दो भट्टः श्रीसार्वभौमकः॥१७॥

nityānandaprabhuścaiva paṇḍitaḥ śrīgadādharaḥ|
purī śrīparamānando bhaṭṭaḥ śrīsārvabhaumakaḥ||17||

nityananda-prabhuh — Nityananda Prabhu; cha eva — and also; panditah — Pandita; shri-gadadharah — Sri Gadadhara; puri — Puri; shri-paramanandah — Sri Paramananda; bhattah — Bhatta; shri-sarvabhaumakah — Sri Sarvabhauma.

17Nityananda Prabhu and Sri Gadadhara Pandita; Sri Paramananda Puri and Sri Sarvabhauma Bhatta;

Verse 18

पण्डितो जगदानन्दस्तथा श्रीकाशीमिश्रकः।
दामोदरस्वरूपश्च पण्डितः शङ्करस्तथा॥१८॥

paṇḍito jagadānandastathā śrīkāśīmiśrakaḥ|
dāmodarasvarūpaśca paṇḍitaḥ śaṅkarastathā||18||

panditah — Pandita; jagadanandah — Jagadananda; tatha — also; shri-kashi-mishrakah — Sri Kashi Mishra; damodara-svarupah — Damodara Svarupa; cha — and; panditah — Pandita; shankarah — Shankara; tatha — also.

18Jagadananda Pandita and Sri Kashi Mishra; Damodara Svarupa and Shankara Pandita;

Verse 19

श्रीकाशीश्वरगोस्वामी पण्डितो भगवांस्तथा।
श्रीलप्रद्युम्नमिश्रः श्रीपरमानन्दपात्रकः॥१९॥

śrīkāśīśvaragosvāmī paṇḍito bhagavāṁstathā|
śrīlapradyumnamiśraḥ śrīparamānandapātrakaḥ||19||

shri-kashishvara-gosvami — Sri Kashishvara Gosvami; panditah — Pandita; bhagavan — Bhagavan; tatha — also; shrila-pradyumna-mishrah — Srila Pradyumna Mishra; shri-paramananda-patrakah — Sri Paramananda Patra.

19Sri Kashishvara Gosvami and Bhagavan Pandita; Srila Pradyumna Mishra and Sri Paramananda Patra;

Verse 20

श्रीरामानन्दरायश्च गोविन्दो द्वारपालकः।
ब्रह्मानन्दभारती च श्रीरूपः श्रीसनातनः॥२०॥

śrīrāmānandarāyaśca govindo dvārapālakaḥ|
brahmānandabhāratī ca śrīrūpaḥ śrīsanātanaḥ||20||

shri-ramananda-rayah — Sri Ramananda Raya; cha — and; govindah — Govinda; dvara-palakah — the doorkeeper; brahmananda-bharati — Brahmananda Bharati; cha — and; shri-rupah — Sri Rupa; shri-sanatanah — Sri Sanatana.

20Sri Ramananda Raya and Govinda the doorkeeper; Brahmananda Bharati, Sri Rupa and Sri Sanatana;

Verse 21

श्रीरघुनाथदासश्च वैद्यः श्रीरघुनाथकः।
श्रीनारायणनन्दाख्य आचार्यपुत्रनन्दनः॥२१॥

śrīraghunāthadāsaśca vaidyaḥ śrīraghunāthakaḥ|
śrīnārāyaṇanandākhya ācāryaputranandanaḥ||21||

shri-raghunatha-dasah — Sri Raghunatha Dasa; cha — and; vaidyah — the physician; shri-raghunathakah — Sri Raghunatha; shri-narayana-nanda-akhyah — named Sri Narayana-nanda; acharya-putra-nandanah — the son of the Acharya, his delight.

21Sri Raghunatha Dasa and Sri Raghunatha the physician; the one called Sri Narayana-nanda6; the son of the Acharya and His delight,

Verse 22

अच्युतानन्दगोस्वामी गौराङ्गप्राणवल्लभः।
शिखिमाहेतिविख्यातो वाणीनाथस्तथापरे॥२२॥

acyutānandagosvāmī gaurāṅgaprāṇavallabhaḥ|
śikhimāhetivikhyāto vāṇīnāthastathāpare||22||

achyutananda-gosvami — Achyutananda Gosvami; gauranga-prana-vallabhah — dear to Gauranga as life; shikhimaha — Shikhi Mahiti; iti — thus; vikhyatah — known; vaninathah — Vaninatha; tatha — also; apare — others.

22Achyutananda Gosvami, dear to Gauranga as life itself; the one known as Shikhi Mahiti, Vaninatha and others —

Verse 23

ये क्षेत्रवासिनो भक्ता आययुः प्रभुणा सह।
एतैः समन्वितः कृष्णचैतन्यो भक्तवत्सलः॥२३॥

ye kṣetravāsino bhaktā āyayuḥ prabhuṇā saha|
etaiḥ samanvitaḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyo bhaktavatsalaḥ||23||

ye — who; kshetra-vasinah — dwelling in the Kshetra; bhaktah — devotees; ayayuh — went; prabhuna saha — with the Lord; etaih — by them; samanvitah — accompanied; krishna-chaitanyah — Krishna Chaitanya; bhakta-vatsalah — loving to His devotees.

23all the devotees who lived in the Kshetra went with the Lord. Accompanied by them, Krishna Chaitanya, who loves His devotees,

Verse 24

श्रीनरेन्द्रसरस्तीरमागतः परमेश्वरः।
तत्राद्वैतोऽपि भगवान् सभक्तः समुपस्थितः॥२४॥

śrīnarendrasarastīramāgataḥ parameśvaraḥ|
tatrādvaito'pi bhagavān sabhaktaḥ samupasthitaḥ||24||

shri-narendra-sarah-tiram — to the shore of glorious Lake Narendra; agatah — came; parama-ishvarah — the Supreme Lord; tatra — there; advaitah — Advaita; api — too; bhagavan — divine; sa-bhaktah — with the devotees; samupasthitah — arrived.

24the Supreme Lord, came to the shore of glorious Lake Narendra; and there divine Advaita too arrived with His devotees.

Verse 25

उभयोर्दर्शनादेव सर्वे जातमहोत्सवाः।
अश्रुकम्पादयो भावा मूर्तिमन्तस्तदा बभुः॥२५॥

ubhayordarśanādeva sarve jātamahotsavāḥ|
aśrukampādayo bhāvā mūrtimantastadā babhuḥ||25||

ubhayoh — of both; darshanat — from the sight; eva — indeed; sarve — all; jata-maha-utsavah — seized by great jubilation; ashru-kampa-adayah — tears, trembling and the rest; bhavah — the ecstatic signs; murtimantah — embodied; tada — then; babhuh — appeared.

25At the very sight of the two of Them all were filled with great jubilation: tears, trembling and the other signs of love seemed then to appear in bodily form.

Thus ends the seventeenth sarga, "The Favour to the Devotees" (Bhakta-anugraha), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Pradyumna Brahmachari is the one whom the Lord named Nrisimhananda.
  2. "Kholavecha" (Bengali): "seller of khola," cups and leaves of the banana plant; Shridhara was a poor banana-seller of Navadvipa.
  3. That is, the author of the poem himself, Murari Gupta, a physician by caste.
  4. Mukunda, Narahari (Sarakara), Chiranjiva and Sulochana were devotees of Shrikhanda.
  5. Ramananda Vasu and Satyaraja (Khan) were devotees of Kulinagrama.
  6. The name is unclear; possibly two persons are meant, Narayana and Nanda.
